subject: spanish
title: Saying Your Name
welcome_lead: Me llamo and Como te llamas.
final_note: Tell someone your name in Spanish.

concepts.def: My name is (lit. I call myself).

walkthroughs.body_html: Me llamo + name. 'Me llamo Sam'. Ask: Como te llamas? — informal. Note the double 'll' sounds like 'y' in 'yes'.
Como estas? = How are you? Reply: Estoy bien (I'm well) or asi asi (so-so). Then ask back: Y tu?
When meeting someone new, say Mucho gusto — 'pleased to meet you'. In Spain, kiss each cheek (a girl) or shake hands.

options: Could be his/her/your(formal)/their brother - context determines which.
